noise.scope:
Compare original effect noise initialization and its cube-face consumers.

Explicit seeds and captured allocator state are research preconditions. Native
inputs are seeds only. This is not full template-loader/startup RNG validation.
Triangles compare exact multisets including attributes and multiplicity; retail
strip order/winding are not required to match and no raster equality is claimed.

shadow.scope:
Verify native effect24 geometry factories, draw transforms/materials and UV sharing.

Shape3 compares exact triangle multisets because retail strip optimization changes
order. Other geometry compares ordered vertices. No numerical tolerance is used.
This does not prove raster equivalence, global template-load RNG, or service54.
shadow.sphere_comparison: Exact triangle multiset including multiplicity; order and winding differ. No raster equality claim.
